purpose: Exact-source hosted qualification of the frozen official architecture provider selection and retained native Windows ordinary/high packet, ownership and physical cleanup mechanisms. This is not full W22 two-target acceptance.

build_provenance.driver: Official Wintun 0.14.1 amd64, frozen archive and per-architecture hashes; Authenticode Valid/WireGuard LLC and binary license retained. Protected execution copy matches the Actions-built executable.

cases.provider_negative: passed: protected official architecture DLL opens; retained image pin prevents write-open; wrong digest, another architecture pin, protected unsigned bytes with their matching operator digest, and official bytes on an ordinary-writable path all refused; original official bytes unchanged
cases.normal: passed: actual medium owner/high helper and exact original image binding, complete original kernel snapshot, real IPv4/IPv6 1280-byte UDP request/reply, foreign process rejection, original adapter absent and journal/receipt cleared
cases.nonoriginal_identity: passed: changed interface index, LUID, alias and GUID refused individually; complete original snapshot and captured PnP instance unchanged after every rejection
cases.crash: passed: helper killed without destructors; recovery refused live original ordinary process; ordinary process killed; production exact-original PnP recovery and physical absence succeeded
cases.raw_peer: passed: distinct medium same-SID raw named-pipe client sent public hello plus exact plan digest and was denied by actual OS peer identity; final adapter/journal/receipt absent

remaining_scope: Real production login/one-use online authority and remote carrier integration, independent Windows/Linux targets, partial-install faults and other-VPN coexistence require their own applicable evidence.
local_review: Downloaded and read/checksummed retained Actions output only. No local driver execution, compilation, formatter, lint or project test.
